$comment: Canonical machine-readable rules for tokens/tokens.json. Edited by hand; validated and consumed by tools/build_tokens.py. Documented in docs/token-profile.md.
dtcg_note: Shaped like the W3C Design Tokens format ($value/$type/$description/{alias}) but NOT validated against it and not claimed compatible: gradient and shadow are CSS strings, number carries a unit extension, dimensions are limited to px/rem/em.

themes.scoping: Day is declared on :root and is the default. Night redeclares only the semantic variables whose value differs from day. It applies to a subtree with class ts-night, to the whole document with data-theme=dark on :root, or to the whole document when the OS prefers dark unless data-theme=light is set. Selectors, cascade and color-scheme behaviour are kept from the pre-BK-03A tokens.css.

zero_durations.reason: pointer/gyro follow; tilt is disabled under reduced motion
sheets, toasts and style swaps become instant
tilt return and card flip become instant
non-essential decorative loop: a zero duration leaves the foil sweep static (a still sheen); consumers still own the animation itself

reduced_motion.loop_policy: Non-essential looping motion (print-sweep) is static under reduced motion. This file only sets duration variables; stopping runtime animation (tilt, spin, glitch, sound) is consumer-owned.

external_fonts.note: Font files in fonts/ are not wired to any @font-face by this repository. tokens.css never loads a font. Loading Google Fonts is a legacy, explicit opt-in stylesheet; it is not a font provider decision.

tailwind.supported: tailwindcss 3.4.x (tested with 3.4.19); Tailwind 4 is not supported or tested
